error[ZBX-E0521]: the image's user is not in the image
  while  choosing the user the image runs as
  cause  the image runs as user 'ghost', which /etc/passwd in the image has no
         entry for
  user   ghost
  file   /etc/passwd
  fix    the image's configuration is wrong; try another tag of it
  more   zbx explain E0521
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0521.html
